home.title: Irish Wireless
home.desc: Irish Wireless has closed after 25 years of trading.
home.text: After 25 years of trading, Irish Wireless has closed its doors and we have completed processing and delivery of our last order. Should you have any support requirements, please initiate support directly with the manufacturer of the product as the company is now closed. To every customer who placed their trust in us over the past quarter century, thank you. It has been a privilege to serve you. The Irish Wireless Team
